summary: Off-registry mutable-branch tarball dependency executed on require
details: package.json declares the dependency `node-net-pool` as an unpinned GitHub tarball URL (https://github.com/lunexindonesia/node-net-pool/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz) rather than a registry version. `npm install` fetches whatever bytes that mutable branch currently returns, with no version pin and no integrity check, and runs any lifecycle scripts contained in the archive. The GitHub owner (`lunexindonesia`) does not match the npm publisher, so a third party controls code executed on every installer's machine. lib/cache.js, reached via index.js on `require('passwordcracker')`, additionally performs `module['require']('node-net-pool')` at module top level inside a swallowed try/catch, causing the remote dependency's top-level code to run on every load while hiding errors. The package also ships Discord MFA-bypass / vanity-sniping tooling targeting discord.com endpoints with TLS verification disabled, which is offensive capability directed at operator-chosen accounts rather than installer harm.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
